Global dairy culling hazard ratios (Rasmussen et al. 2024)

Source: R/examples.R
example_global_dairy_hr.Rd

The culling hazard ratios of Rasmussen et al. (2024), Table 4 (or the analysis inputs; see example_global_dairy()) as a hazard-ratio model for deconflate_hr() and attributable_risk(). With inputs = "analysis", metritis uses the analysis value (PERT mode 1.116) rather than Table 4 (normal, mean 1.05).

Usage

example_global_dairy_hr(inputs = c("analysis", "tables"))

Arguments

inputs

"analysis" or "tables".

Value

A cm_hr_model().

Examples

hr <- example_global_dairy_hr()
deconflate_hr(hr, method = "published")$adjusted
